title: TPXimpact gets the same open-source-by-default tailwind as Made Tech
content:
TPXimpact is a listed UK public-sector pure play at GBP 78.1m, and the research notes it is recovering. The reason it appears next to Made Tech is that both draw the same regulatory tailwind: UK public sector operates under an open-source-by-default mandate, so a supplier's posture is set by the buyer rather than chosen by the supplier.

Being a pure play sharpens that. A mixed consultancy can treat default-open government work as one practice among several, with its own carve-outs; a firm whose whole revenue base is public sector has no non-mandated business to fall back on, so every engagement carries the same disclosure expectations.

The recovery note is the risk to weigh against it — a listed firm working through a downturn is likely to be selective about unfunded pilots. Nothing in the record establishes its stack or its own contribution history; only the regime and the shape of the business are on file. Priority 2.
